audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers claimed 'Malzahar has no early poke tools' and 'almost no early trading tools beyond auto-attacking behind his Void Swarm minions'.
audit.why: Call of the Void is a 900-range silence on a flat 6-second cooldown — longer range than anything he needs and the reason your escape paint can be denied. Malefic Visions at 650 is a damage-over-time that spreads on a kill.
audit.corrected: Even at 5.5/10, 54.34% over 3,246 games. He pokes at 900 and silences; the lane is won by out-ranging that wind-up, not by pretending it is absent.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer phases[N].side read 'Skill' while content win[] read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Malzahar/Hwei/Hwei and matched the packet levelChart — flattening the one row that genuinely belongs to him.
audit.why: Levels 1-5 he cannot trade with the two-paint detonation. Level 6 is his: a 700-range channelled suppress on 140 seconds. After first item your burst beats his damage-over-time again.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side to Hwei, phases[4].side to Malzahar at 7/10, phases[5..6].side to Hwei, with each why rewritten to the row's verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: None of the three real interactions were on the page, Void Shift was called a 'passive shield', and content referenced a nonexistent 'W Null Zone' plus a Hwei 'W wall'.
audit.why: Riot's data flags Nether Grasp as a channel — any CC cancels it. Void Shift is massive damage reduction plus crowd-control immunity that lingers only while he has not recently taken damage, so it is stripped by chip, not by a shield breaking. Call of the Void silences. Malzahar's W is Void Swarm; Hwei's W line is Fleeting Current, Pool of Reflection and Stirring Lights — no wall.
audit.corrected: Hold one E paint to cancel the Nether Grasp channel; land any damage first so Void Shift's CC immunity is gone before you count on the fear; treat the silence as the reason not to pre-cast your answer.

audit.why: Nether Grasp 140/110/80 at 700, Call of the Void flat 6s at 900, Malefic Visions 11/10/9/8/7 at 650, Void Swarm 8s.
audit.corrected: Numbers written in with the channel-cancel and Void Shift lines attached.

audit.whatIsWrong: Malefic Visions' execute-threshold behaviour was nowhere on the page.
audit.why: brief.missingInteractions flags execute-threshold: the DoT keeps ticking and passes to a nearby unit if the target dies.
audit.corrected: Not written into a field this pass — Riot's text does not give the threshold number and the kit entry is truncated, so I will not put a magnitude on it. Recorded in notes.

notes: The biggest defect here was factual, not cosmetic: both layers said Malzahar has no early poke. He has Call of the Void, 900 range, flat 6s, and it silences — which is precisely why 'hold the E paint rather than pre-casting' matters. Also removed a nonexistent 'W Null Zone' (his W is Void Swarm) and a Hwei 'W wall' (his W line is Fleeting Current, Pool of Reflection, Stirring Lights). Void Shift was described as a 'passive shield'; it is damage reduction plus CC immunity that lapses once he takes damage, which changes the order of your combo. Chart: content win[] already matched the packet levelChart and all seven full sides read 'Skill', so six rows moved with no paired win[N] edit because the content layer already holds the target value — verify the applier does not hold the group back for that. Malefic Visions' execute-threshold interaction is still unwritten: Riot's text in the kit file is truncated mid-sentence and gives no threshold number, so I would not put a magnitude on it.
